entries.zh: 缺；缺少，稀罕难得、不易寻得
entries.en: to lack, be missing; rare, not to be found

entries.zh: 久缺；缺了很久，久而不见
entries.en: long missing; to have been lacking for a long time
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节声调污损难辨（T99），据汉字'缺久'与西语释义仍可定'久缺'，故照规则降低置信。

entries.zh: 物罕有；东西罕有，难得一见
entries.en: things rarely had; scarce, seldom to be found

entries.zh: 罕有；稀有，少见
entries.en: rare, seldom seen; scarce
entries.notes: 西语词头残断（rar-），据字母序与前文 raro 词群推为 raro；汉字与音写明确。

entries.zh: 罕得；很少得到，难得
entries.en: seldom obtained; rarely to be gotten
entries.notes: 西语词头残断（rar-），据字母序推为 raro；汉字与音写明确。

entries.zh: 希罕；稀罕，少见难得
entries.en: rare, uncommon

entries.zh: 缺见；难得见到，罕遇
entries.en: seldom seen; rarely to be seen

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕原文'缺迅'：字面'缺+迅'不成常词，或与'缺稀、罕见'同类，语义无法定夺
entries.en: sense uncertain: lit. 'lacking + swift', not a common compound; per context of 'raro' possibly 'rare, scarce'
entries.notes: 西语栏残损难解，M 栏第二音节声调污损（T99），'缺迅'不成常词，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 特别奇巧，少见而别致
entries.en: rare, particular; unusual, peculiar

entries.zh: 稀罕，少见；（西语举例）住户稀少
entries.en: rare, uncommon; (ex.) few inhabitants

entries.zh: 零散人；人丁零散稀少，人烟寥落
entries.en: men few and scattered; people dispersed and scarce
entries.notes: H 栏第二字有[疑]标注（汕/散两读），据西语'raros hombres pocos'与音写 sān 定为'散'。

entries.zh: 搔，抓痒；又指爬、攀爬
entries.en: to scratch (an itch); to claw, scrape
entries.notes: R 栏仅存残字'ě'，据 L/H/M 三栏互证定为搔抓之义。

entries.zh: 楸；以指尖搔抓、掐弄
entries.en: to scratch with the tip of the finger; to pinch, pick
entries.notes: M 栏两音节（chiù-lǒ）而 H 栏仅录'楸'一字，原稿疑脱一字；义据西语'以指尖搔抓'定。

entries.zh: 楸唠；恶意捋弄他人胡须，互相讥讽嘲弄
entries.en: to scratch another's beard in malice; to taunt, jeer at one another

entries.zh: 绫；有细纹的丝织物（对译西语 raso'缎'）
entries.en: satin (raso); a fine figured silk fabric

entries.zh: 绫地花绸；以绫为地织出花纹的绸缎，提花绫绸
entries.en: flowered damask; silk woven with figures on a damask ground

entries.zh: 素绸；素色无花纹的绸缎（西语或为'黑素缎' raso negro）
entries.en: plain satin; undecorated black silk cloth
entries.notes: R 栏第三音节污损难辨（T99，'nyfw'），释义据 H'綢素'与 M'cāng sǔ'定为素绸，照规则降低置信。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕原文'景家'：不成常词，疑为缎类织品名，难以定夺
entries.en: sense uncertain: Chinese compound 'jing-jia' unexplained; apparently another satin/silk fabric type, undecidable
entries.notes: 西语词头残损（'negav'）、R 栏仅存'oy'，汉字'景家'不成常词，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕原文'風隙'：字面'风之隙'，或指透风的缝隙，语义无法定夺
entries.en: sense uncertain: lit. 'wind-gap', possibly an air-crack/vent; Spanish headword corrupted
entries.notes: 西语词头'razo, de montado'残损难解，'風隙'非通行词，仅据字面暂解。

entries.zh: 盖；覆盖，盖子〔整条释义存疑：西语词头残损，R 栏涉马尼拉量器/箱匣名 caban，难以定夺〕
entries.en: to cover; a lid/cover — entry partly obscure (corrupt Spanish headword; R column cites 'caban', a Manila measure/chest term)
entries.notes: 西语词头'Raso ſe medir'残损难解，M 栏三音节不成常词，R 栏仅存'ad. caban'；仅'盖=覆盖'可据汉字确定。
